name: v2.31.0
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: open audit log and tee/once files as UTF-8 by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2429
* Support DELIMITER in batch input by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2430
* fix: read /source and editor files as UTF-8 by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2432
* Read and write batch and checkpoint files as UTF-8 by @Alpenj in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2434
* Bracket IPv6 hosts in the DSN shown and saved by \dsn by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2431
* End use and source at the newline in batch input by @jayhemnani9910 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2433
* Bracket IPv6 literals in prompt strings by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2435
* Prepare changelog for release v2.31.0 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2436

## New Contributors
* @jayhemnani9910 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2430
* @Alpenj made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2434
* @Kernel-Hunter made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2431

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.30.4...v2.31.0
